children: STOXX DIPS IN ERRATIC TRADE AS TECH DRAGS, ENERGY UP

European shares edged lower in choppy early trade on Thursday as bond yields hovered near multi-year highs following Wednesday's selloff, while Brent crude extended gains above the $100-a-barrel mark.
Technology (.SX8P) stocks led declines, falling 1% to pare part of a recent rally, while energy shares (.SXEP) moved closer to record highs.
Industrials, utilities and financials were also weaker.
Almost 55% of STOXX 600 constituents traded in negative territory.
